'''C4K0''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] that operated during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], C4K0 served as a guide for a [[Restimar Mining Corporation]] [[Team 1044|team]] in the [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] mines of the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Tilnes]], where the team was attempting to mine crystals as part of [[Operation Cracked Crystal]], in violation of a trade agreement with the [[Verga Mer Mining Company]]. However, during the operation an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] damaged C4K0 and the rest of the team's [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and equipment. The team attempted to dismantle C4K0 and use its parts to repair their equipment, but this caused the droid to become erratic and start attacking them.
